se.work: Since 11 June 2026 a higher education student on a new or extended permit may work at most 15 hours a week during term, with no cap in June, July and August (Migrationsverket rule as reported by KPMG and The Scholars Dream). Permits granted before that date keep the old rules until the next extension. Exceeding the cap can lead to the permit being revoked or not extended, and an extension also asks for at least 37.5 credits in the first year and 45 a year after.
se.stay_back: Up to 12 months on a residence permit to look for work or start a business after a completed bachelor or master programme (12 to 18 months after doctoral studies); it cannot be extended. You need at least two semesters of study in Sweden and SEK 10,656 a month in funds for the whole period for 2026 applications (Migrationsverket rule as quoted by EnglishJobsSweden, September 2026).

uz.work: The student visa carries no work right: three 2026 guides (StandYou, GoHijrat, Visit World) say any paid work needs a work permit, and some universities allow on campus jobs or internships. Do not budget for wages; confirm with your university and the migration office.
uz.stay_back: No automatic post-study job search permit found (StandYou, 2026). To stay after graduating an employer has to sponsor a work permit and you change from the student visa; the guides do not name an official page, so confirm with the migration service.

ge.stay_back: Sources disagree. StandYou and Leverage Edu say Georgia has no formal post-study work visa and a work residence permit needs an employer offer; LeapScholar describes a 1 year temporary residence permit to seek employment. No official page was read, so ask the Public Service Hall before you count on a job search period.

kg.work: Student visa holders may not work, full time or part time, according to KSMA as quoted by studycountry.com (October 2026); StandYou also says a separate work permit is needed and part time jobs are mostly informal. Older agency pages claiming part time work is allowed are not backed by an official page. Plan to pay for your studies without wages.
kg.stay_back: No post-study work visa: official sources checked by studycountry.com (October 2026) name none. A graduate who wants to work needs an employer to arrange a work visa and work permit, issued together as a Unified Permit on the e-visa portal.

kz.stay_back: No formal post-study work visa found (StandYou, 2026). To stay and work after graduating you need a job offer and an employer sponsored work permit, applied for through the Citizen Service Centre (egov.kz describes the work permit steps). Confirm the current rule with the Migration Service.

ph.stay_back: No post-study work visa or job seeking stay: the 9(f) student visa is tied to enrolment and the Bureau of Immigration visa list has none (studiesmultiverse.com, checked 4 Oct 2026; studycountry.com, 18 Oct 2026). To remain and work an employer must sponsor an Alien Employment Permit and the matching work visa (for example the 9(g) pre-arranged employment visa).

faq_add.q: Which colleges teach Buddhist studies and Sowa Rigpa in Nepal?
faq_add.a: Lumbini Buddhist University lists 30 programmes on lbu.edu.np (19 Nov 2026). The Central Campus in Lumbini runs the Ph.D. in Buddhist Studies, MA in Buddhism and Nepal Studies, MA in Bhot Buddhist Studies, MA in Archaeology and Buddhist Archaeological Sites, Bachelor of Buddhism and Social Work and BA in Rural Development. Affiliated colleges in the Kathmandu valley teach single masters: Sugata Buddhist College (Mahayana), Theravada Buddhist Academy (Theravada and Pali), Lotus Buddhist Academic College (Buddhist Studies, Applied Buddhism), Boudha Multiple Campus (Buddhism and Peace Studies) and Lumbini College of Buddhism and Himalayan Studies. Sowa Rigpa International College near Boudhanath offers the Bachelor of Sowa Rigpa Medicine and Surgery (120 credits).

faq_add.q: Can I study hospitality, tourism or law in Butwal or Tulsipur with a public university degree?
faq_add.a: Yes, through Lumbini Buddhist University. Its City Campus Butwal lists BBA, BTTM, BHTM, BA LL.B., BTCSOL (Chinese teaching) and an MBA in Hospitality Management, and Tulsipur Metro College lists BBA, BHTM and BA LL.B. (lbu.edu.np, 19 Nov 2026). The pages give credits (120 for the bachelor programmes, 220.5 for BA LL.B.) but no fee or seat count, so ask each college for the current fee and intake.

faq_add.q: How much does Nepal Open University cost per credit?
faq_add.a: The Nepal Open University faculty page for Social Sciences and Education (nou.edu.np, 19 Nov 2026) prints tuition per credit: M.Phil. Rs 3,360, MES Rs 1,200, MMCS Rs 1,000, BA Rs 600, B.Ed. (one year) Rs 1,000 and the DLIM diploma Rs 680. Add a one-time admission fee (Rs 2,000, DLIM Rs 1,000), Rs 1,500 library fee a year and Rs 1,000 to 3,000 as the exam fee each semester. The entrance form costs Rs 1,200 for MBA, Rs 1,000 for MSDMG and LL.B. and Rs 300 for BBS. The Management and Law and Science pages print no tuition.

faq_add.q: Where can I study Sanskrit (Shastri and Acharya) in Nepal?
faq_add.a: Nepal Sanskrit University has its central office at Beljhundi, Dang, and its constituent and affiliated Vidyapeeths are spread across the country: Dharan (Pindeshwor), Salleri (B. P. Koirala), Janakpurdham (Janak Hajari), Matihani (Ya.La.), Kathmandu (Valmiki), Chudi (Bhanu), Gaidakot (Kalika), Pokhara (Bindabasini), Bijauri and Beljhundi in Dang, Khidim (Harihar), Ridi (Ruru), Keladighat (Radha Damodar) and Mahendranagar (Sharada). The university site did not answer on 19 Nov 2026, so the list comes from four aggregators that agree; ask the campus which programmes and intake it has this year.

faq_add.q: How many hours can I work as a student in Sweden now?
faq_add.a: Since 11 June 2026 a higher education student on a new or extended permit may work at most 15 hours a week during term, with no limit in June, July and August, according to Migrationsverket as reported by KPMG and The Scholars Dream (19 Nov 2026). Permits granted before that date keep the old rules until their next extension. To extend you also need 37.5 credits in the first year and 45 a year after. After a bachelor or master you can get a 12 month permit to look for work (12 to 18 months after a doctorate).

faq_add.q: Can I work or stay after graduating in Georgia, Kazakhstan, Kyrgyzstan, Uzbekistan or the Philippines?
faq_add.a: None of the five has a post-study job search permit that two or more sources agree on (read 19 Nov 2026). Kyrgyzstan (KSMA via studycountry.com) and the Philippines (Bureau of Immigration visa list) say a student visa gives no work right and a graduate needs an employer sponsored work permit; Uzbekistan and Kazakhstan guides say a work permit and an employer are needed too. For Georgia the guides disagree (one describes a 1 year permit). Plan your budget without student wages and check with the migration office.
